market_summary: Across all 6 symbols, the late New York session is characterized by declining volume and low-volatility consolidation following earlier intraday trends. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD remain submerged well below their session VWAPs and EMA50 structural baselines, yet lack the yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout volume or clean liquidity sweeps necessary to justify continuation shorts. US100 holds above VWAP after an afternoon recovery but is encountering resistance at its EMA20 baseline with neutral delta. With markets entering late-session chop and liquidity drying up, all instruments warrant a disciplined HOLD.
